margherita.name: Margherita
margherita.summary: Tomato, fior di latte and basil: three clear flavours on a soft, light dough.
margherita.description: A Margherita leaves nowhere to hide. Bright tomato, well-drained mozzarella and a few basil leaves are enough when every ingredient is used with restraint.
margherita.imageAlt: Top view of a Margherita pizza topped with mozzarella and basil
ingredients: 80 g hand-crushed peeled tomatoes per pizza
80 g well-drained fior di latte per pizza
3 to 4 fresh basil leaves
Extra-virgin olive oil and a pinch of salt
steps: Crush the tomatoes by hand with a pinch of salt; do not cook them.
Open the dough while keeping a puffy rim, then spread the tomato in a spiral.
Add small, spaced pieces of fior di latte and a drizzle of oil.
Bake very hot, then add the basil as soon as the pizza leaves the oven.

marinara.name: Marinara
marinara.summary: Tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil: a cheeseless pizza with a clean, intense aroma.
marinara.description: The Marinara is all about contrast between fresh tomato, finely sliced garlic and oregano. Its light topping lets the dough take centre stage.
marinara.imageAlt: Artisan tomato pizza with basil and garlic on a wooden table
ingredients: 90 g hand-crushed peeled tomatoes per pizza
1 small garlic clove, finely sliced
A pinch of dried oregano
Extra-virgin olive oil and a few basil leaves
steps: Season the crushed tomatoes lightly with salt.
Open the dough, then spread the tomato to within two centimetres of the rim.
Scatter over the garlic and oregano, then finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
Bake very hot and add the fresh basil as the pizza leaves the oven.

marinara-garnie.name: Dressed marinara
marinara-garnie.summary: A marinara baked bare, then covered out of the oven with stracciatella, cherry tomatoes and rocket.
marinara-garnie.description: Everything happens out of the oven. The pizza bakes as a marinara, without cheese, and is only dressed once it comes out: the stracciatella stays creamy, the rocket crisp and the cherry tomatoes fresh.
marinara-garnie.imageAlt: Tomato pizza covered with rocket and cherry tomatoes, with a ball of mozzarella at the centre
ingredients: 90 g hand-crushed peeled tomatoes per pizza
1 small garlic clove, finely sliced
A pinch of dried oregano
100 g stracciatella per pizza (or a very melty mozzarella, burrata heart included)
8 cherry tomatoes, halved, per pizza
A large handful of rocket per pizza
3 to 4 slices of Parma ham or speck per pizza (optional)
Parmesan shavings and balsamic vinegar, to taste (optional)
Extra-virgin olive oil and freshly ground pepper
steps: Season the crushed tomatoes lightly with salt.
Open the dough, then spread the tomato to within two centimetres of the rim.
Scatter over the garlic and oregano, then bake very hot like a plain marinara.
Out of the oven, spoon over spaced dollops of stracciatella so it stays creamy.
Cover generously with rocket and cherry tomatoes, then add the Parma ham or speck.
Still out of the oven, finish with a drizzle of olive oil, a twist of pepper and, to taste, parmesan shavings and a few drops of balsamic, then serve straight away.

reine.name: Reine
reine.summary: Ham, mushrooms and mozzarella on a thin, golden dough with just enough crunch.
reine.description: A balanced Reine keeps every topping distinct: mushrooms seared so they stay dry, restrained slices of ham and a light scattering of mozzarella.
reine.imageAlt: Golden pizza topped with ham, mushrooms, mozzarella and herbs
reine.doughSuggestion: Direct Roman dough with oil · 24 hours
ingredients: 70 g tomato sauce per pizza
70 g well-drained mozzarella per pizza
50 g cooked ham cut into strips per pizza
60 g sliced and seared chestnut mushrooms per pizza
steps: Sear the mushrooms over high heat to remove their water, then leave them to cool.
Open the dough thinly and spread over a light layer of tomato sauce.
Add the mozzarella, mushrooms and finally the strips of ham.
Bake until the base is golden and serve with a twist of black pepper.

quatre-fromages.name: Four cheeses
quatre-fromages.summary: Ricotta, fior di latte, camembert and roquefort, lifted by a drizzle of honey and crushed walnuts.
quatre-fromages.description: A white pizza in two stages: the seasoned ricotta bakes with the dough, while the three other cheeses only go on at the end so they stay molten. Honey, walnuts and basil are added out of the oven.
quatre-fromages.imageAlt: Top view of a white pizza with four melted cheeses on a wooden board
ingredients: 40 g fresh ricotta per pizza
80 g well-drained fior di latte per pizza
25 g thinly sliced camembert per pizza (buffalo camembert if you can find it)
25 g crumbled roquefort per pizza
10 g roughly crushed walnuts
1 tbsp runny honey
Extra-virgin olive oil, pepper and a few basil leaves
steps: Loosen the ricotta with a drizzle of olive oil, salt and a twist of pepper.
Open the dough while keeping a puffy rim, then spread the ricotta to within two centimetres of the edge.
Bake very hot: the ricotta cooks with the dough and loses its excess water.
Take the pizza out, scatter over the fior di latte, camembert and roquefort, then return it to the oven just long enough to melt them.
Out of the oven, add the walnuts, drizzle over the honey, and finish with basil and a last thread of oil.

pesto.name: Pesto
pesto.summary: Basil pesto, confit cherry tomatoes and stracciatella on a base baked bare, with nothing but olive oil.
pesto.description: Nothing goes into the oven with the dough: it bakes on its own, brushed with olive oil. The pesto, confit tomatoes, fior di latte and parmesan only join halfway through, and the stracciatella and basil not until the pizza is out.
pesto.imageAlt: Gourmet pizza topped with burrata and pesto
ingredients: 80 g basil pesto per pizza
60 g confit cherry tomatoes per pizza
50 g well-drained fior di latte per pizza
15 g grated parmesan per pizza
100 g stracciatella per pizza
5 fresh basil leaves
Extra-virgin olive oil and a little fine semolina for shaping
steps: Heat the oven to 250 °C on fan mode, with the baking stone inside if you have one.
Dust the worktop with semolina, then open the dough by hand.
Slide the dough onto a semolina-dusted peel or onto a tray brushed with olive oil.
Brush the whole surface with olive oil, then bake for 8 minutes low in the oven.
Take the pizza out, spread over the pesto, confit tomatoes, fior di latte and parmesan, then return it for 5 minutes on conventional heat.
Out of the oven, finish with spoonfuls of stracciatella and the fresh basil leaves.
